build_three_way_contrastive_head: build a ThreeWayContrastive transformer head for 3-way contrastive classification with MLP and cross entropy loss
create_contrastive_config: create a ThreeWayContrastive Config dataclass with hidden size 768 and 3 labels for VinVL pretraining
run_forward_pass: run the forward pass of ThreeWayContrastive to compute contrastive loss from sequence output and labels
review_contrastive_loss_computation: review the ThreeWayContrastive forward method that computes cross entropy loss on 3-way contrastive scores
test_three_way_contrastive_head: test the ThreeWayContrastive head by passing sequence output and processed sample list with contrastive labels
